core_obligations: Reduce to the case where $Y$ is a scheme, using that the higher direct images may be computed on an etale cover of the target (proof lines 504-506).
Note that then $X$ is a scheme as well, because an integral morphism is representable by schemes (proof lines 507-509).
Apply the integral statement of etale cohomology to obtain exactness of $f_*$ and the vanishing of $R^pf_*$ for $p > 0$, and record the reference for the finite case (proof lines 510-514).
proof_roadmap: Reduction to a scheme base (proof lines 504-506).
The source is a scheme too (proof lines 507-509).
Application of the integral etale cohomology statement (proof lines 510-514).
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that for an integral, in particular finite, morphism of algebraic spaces the pushforward on etale sheaves is exact and all higher direct images vanish (statement lines 495-501). The proof reduces to the case of schemes by computing the higher direct images along an etale cover of the target and invoking representability of integral morphisms, and then applies the corresponding statement for integral morphisms of schemes in etale cohomology. The reduction to schemes is the substance, so the claim is H2.
